newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin press office denies rumours of op delay.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin press office denies rumours of op delay.

text.p: The head of President Boris Yeltsin's press office on Tuesday flatly denied reports on a Moscow radio station that Yeltsin was too sick to undergo planned heart surgery.
"This does not correspond to reality," Igor Ignatyev said of an Ekho Moskvy report that a bypass operation was too risky because Yeltsin's haemoglobin levels were too low.

The radio quoted sources at the Central Clinical Hospital, where Yeltsin, 65, is expected to undergo the operation, as saying haemoglobin levels were so low that few surgeons would recommend an operation in the forseeable future.
A council of Russian and foreign doctors decided late last month that Yeltsin was fit enough for surgery, which could take place within the next two months.
Yeltsin press spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky holds a regular news briefing at 1200 GMT.
